title: Solar panel efficiency
text: Most rooftop solar panels sold today convert about 20 to 23 percent of sunlight into electricity. Efficiency drops slightly as panels get hotter.

title: Rooftop solar in India
text: Rooftop solar in India grows fastest where electricity tariffs are high and roofs are flat. Net metering lets households sell surplus power to the grid.

title: EV battery lifespan
text: Electric vehicle batteries usually last 8 to 15 years before they fall below 70 to 80 percent of their original capacity. Heat and frequent fast charging shorten battery life.

title: Battery recycling
text: Recycling recovers lithium, cobalt and nickel from old batteries. Many used EV batteries first get a second life storing energy for buildings.

title: Wind power basics
text: Wind turbines turn moving air into electricity and work best at sites with steady winds. Offshore wind farms are more expensive to build but produce more power.
